items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Did you have any of Bob Lyons? Bob Lyons. That's the one. You sure get them there. Now, that's the one you used to work for Uncle Jake. Oh, yeah. Bob Lyons was the bass player.

ctx.x: Do you remember Willie Carnage? Did he play slide or vowel or what?

Wait, wait, wait. Well, when I know Willie Carnage, I believe he was playing slide. He was a big, tall fella. He used to be on Rapport Street around Uncle Jake all the time. Him and the... Wait, wait, wait. Him and the fella used to play bass. Well, the bass player used to work for Jake. Uncle Jake there. If you would want a bass or any kind of instrument, he'd go there and get it for you. Tell him Uncle Jake, he stands for you. Did you have any of Bob Lyons? Bob Lyons. That's the one. You sure get them there.…
Because Uncle Jake would have had a pawn...
